lyrics.name: Lyrics
lyrics.description: The words of the song that is playing, line by line, from LRCLIB.
lyrics.privacy: Atap sends the song title, artist and album to lrclib.net to find the lyrics. If you set a translation link, the line playing now is also sent to that link while the widget is open. Nothing else is sent, and song names and lyrics are never logged.
lyrics.romanize: Show Japanese and Korean lines in Latin letters
lyrics.romanizeHint: Adds a line in Latin letters under lyrics written in kana or Hangul.
lyrics.translateUrlHint: Leave empty to turn translation off. Atap puts the line playing now in place of {text} and the language in place of {lang}, for example https://translate.example.com/translate?q={text}&target={lang}. Use your own service or one you trust, since each line is sent to it. The link stays on this PC and is never synced.
lyrics.translatePath: Where the translation is in the reply
lyrics.translatePathHint: The field that holds the translated text, such as translatedText or data.translation.
lyrics.noSong: Play a song to see its lyrics.
lyrics.none: No lyrics found for this song.
lyrics.failed: Could not reach LRCLIB. Check your connection.
